project_description: Build the issue #342 keep-warm orchestration on top of prompt-cache-residency-contract: generation-owned scheduling, A-leg idle epochs triggered by OS-command tool calls, deterministic lifecycle-aware timing, race-safe cancellation on the next real turn, bounded refresh/duration/concurrency budgets, admin per-session disable controls, provider-billable maintenance accounting, observability, and evidence-gated provider rollout. Keep-warm orchestration is enabled by default but never silently enables or changes a provider's foreground cache policy.
